text:
ana: quick note  we rolled an unpin of runtime v2.2.0 into eu-west canary at 03:15 and are seeing a small cluster of adapter_init_failures on tool-heavy sessions. opening thread to decide whether to pin back or flip a compat flag.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v2.2.0 scope=eu-west user=ana run_id=rb-8812 started=3155556500

rohit: seeing ~0.7% adapter_init_fail aggregated across 6m, concentrated on canary nodes. p99 token latency +30ms for those sessions. overall traffic for canary ~2.1% of region.

emily: SDK team chiming in: v2.2.0 introduced an adapter validation change that tightens a handshake; older SDKs fall back but some clients now error out instead of degrading. We have a small SDK patch, but ETA ~3h for release + CI.

ops-ram: options: 1) scoped canary pin to v2.1.8 (fast), 2) enable legacy-handshake for canary if runtime supports it (config flip), 3) accept small error until SDK patch. I'd prefer a scoped pin to keep blast radius minimal.

zane: support: customer impact currently low (~0.05% of global), but some automated integrations may see failures. I'll prepare an internal blurb.

ana: (typo) ana: applying a small pinlist override to avoid global changes. snippet: 
```
runtime_pins:
  eu-west:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v2.1.8  # revert for canary until SDK patch
```

ops-ram: executing: /deploybot pin runtime v2.1.8 --scope=eu-west --cohort=canary --reason "adapter_init_fail after v2.2.0 unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v2.1.8 scope=eu-west cohort=canary user=ops-ram run_id=rb-8812 status=started ts=3155556820

ops-ram: pinned canary. monitoring error rate and p99. will wait 8m before deciding on prod roll.

rohit: 5m in: adapter_init_fail down to 0.04% and p95 latency back to baseline on pinned canary nodes. logs look clean.

emily: SDK patch PR opened (PR #10801) and linked to CI. If we can get two green canary preflights after merge, we can schedule a staged unpin.

zane: internal note posted to SRE and CS channels. customer comms draft ready but on hold.

ops-ram: plan: keep canary pinned, block further unpins for eu-west while we wait for SDK merge + 2 green preflights. change window open until 06:00 UTC; will not push to prod without release lead sign-off.

ana: minor follow-ups: @emily expedite SDK PR (#10801) and add a regression test for adapter-handshake (INC-8812-1), @rohit add adapter init smoke to preflight (INC-8812-2), @zane prepare customer note (INC-8812-3).

ops-ram: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-8812 actions=unpin(v2.2.0,eu-west)->pin(v2.1.8,eu-west canary) status=canary-pin duration=222s

ana: thanks team  we'll keep safehold until follow-ups complete. closing thread for now.
